title: Integrability of oscillators and transcendental invariant curves
summary: In this work we study the integrability of a family of nonlinear oscillators. Dynamical systems from this family appear in different applications from mechanics to chemistry. We propose an approach for finding first integrals and integrating factors, which is based on the construction and classification of transcendental invariant curves whose cofactors are polynomial or rational in one of the variables.
